en.headline: More than 160,000 sign up for Huanggang joint clearance
en.dek: Immigration officials said the mobile-app enrolments were completed by Friday noon, three days after registration opened.
body: More than 160,000 Hong Kong residents had registered by Friday noon for collaborative-inspection automated channels at the rebuilt Huanggang Port, the Immigration Department said.

Assistant director Jacky Wong said the figure covered enrolments on the department's mobile app since registration opened three days earlier, and that he expected the number to rise after the port opens on Monday. Travellers can also register on site. He said enrolment takes seconds and should not hold up clearance, and that staff would be on hand to help.

Under the co-location arrangement, passengers complete Hong Kong and mainland immigration checks in one stop. Wong said Hong Kong residents using the automated channels need present either a Hong Kong identity card or a home-return permit, but should still carry both documents.

Authorities said the model is intended to cut overall clearance time from about 30 minutes to about five minutes. They said staffing at the round-the-clock crossing would be adjusted as passenger numbers require. The port is due to open for passenger clearance at 6:30am on Monday.

zh.headline: 逾16萬人已登記皇崗協作查驗自助通道
zh.dek: 入境處表示，截至周五中午，市民經流動應用程式完成登記的人數已超過16萬，登記開放約三日。
body: 入境事務處周五表示，截至中午，已有超過16萬名香港居民登記使用重建後皇崗口岸的協作查驗自助通道。
入境處助理處長在簡報會上說，數字是登記開放約三日以來，經該處流動應用程式完成的申請，預計口岸周一開通後還會上升。旅客亦可在現場登記。他說登記只需數秒，不會拖慢通關，入境處會安排職員協助。
在一地兩檢安排下，旅客可在同一處完成香港及內地的出入境手續。他表示，香港居民使用自助通道時，出示香港身份證或回鄉證其中一種即可，但仍應同時攜帶兩份證件。
當局稱，這個模式旨在把整體通關時間由約30分鐘縮至約5分鐘，並會按人流彈性調配24小時口岸的人手。口岸定於周一早上6時30分開始旅客通關。
